    WHEN DATEDIFF('day', l_shipdate, l_receiptdate) BETWEEN 8 AND 14 THEN '08-14'
    WHEN DATEDIFF('day', l_shipdate, l_receiptdate) BETWEEN 15 AND 21 THEN '15-21'

WITH filtered_customers AS (
    SELECT o_custkey
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY o_custkey
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_mktsegment,
        DATE_DIFF('day',
            LAG(o.o_orderdate) OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_custkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate),
            o.o_orderdate) AS gap
    FROM customer c
    JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    WHERE c.c_custkey IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM filtered_customers)
)
SELECT
    c_mktsegment,
    AVG(gap) AS avg_gap_days,
    COUNT(*) AS gap_count
FROM gaps
GROUP BY c_mktsegment
ORDER BY c_mktsegment

WITH nation_avg AS (
    SELECT
        n.n_name,
        AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS nation_avg_acctbal
    FROM customer c
    JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    GROUP BY n.n_name
)
SELECT
    n.n_name,
    na.nation_avg_acctbal,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.c_acctbal > na.nation_avg_acctbal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS above_avg_count
FROM customer c
JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN nation_avg na ON n.n_name = na.n_name
GROUP BY n.n_name, na.nation_avg_acctbal
ORDER BY n.n_name

WITH supplier_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_name,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
    FROM
        lineitem l
    JOIN

SELECT
    o_orderstatus,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count,
    SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_price,
    AVG(o_totalprice) AS avg_price
FROM
    orders
WHERE
    o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01'
    AND o_orderdate < '1996-01-01'
GROUP BY
    o_orderstatus
ORDER BY
    o_orderstatus

1.  **Analyze the Request:**
    *   Goal: Create a summary report for orders placed in 1995.
    *   Columns needed: `o_orderstatus`, `order_count`, `total_price`, `avg_price`.

WITH transit_days AS (
  SELECT 
    l.l_receiptdate - l.l_shipdate AS transit_days,
    l.l_discount
  FROM lineitem l
  WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01' 
    AND l.l_shipdate < '1995-01-01'
),
bucketed AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN transit_days >= 1 AND transit_days <= 7 THEN '01-07'
      WHEN transit_days >= 8 AND transit_days <= 14 THEN '08-14'
      WHEN transit_days >= 15 AND transit_days <= 21 THEN '15-21'
      WHEN transit_days >= 22 AND transit_days <= 30 THEN '22-30'
    END AS bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    AVG(l_discount) AS avg_discount
  FROM transit_days
  GROUP BY bucket
)
SELECT 
  bucket,
  line_count,
  avg_discount
FROM bucketed
ORDER BY bucket

    l_shipmode,
    q1,
    q2,
    q3,
    q4
FROM (
    SELECT
        l_shipmode,
        CASE
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l_shipdate) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'q1'
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l_shipdate) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'q2'
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l_shipdate) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'q3'
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l_shipdate) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN 'q4'
        END AS q1,
        CASE
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l_shipdate) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'q1'
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l_shipdate) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'q2'
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l_shipdate) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'q3'
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l_shipdate) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN 'q4'
        END AS q2,
        CASE
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l_shipdate) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'q1'
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l_shipdate) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'q2'
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l_shipdate) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'q3'
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l_shipdate) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN 'q4'
        END AS q3,
        CASE
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l_shipdate) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'q1'
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l_shipdate) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'q2'
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l_shipdate) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'q3'
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l_shipdate) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN 'q4'
        END AS q4
    FROM lineitem
    WHERE l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1996-01-01'
)
GROUP BY l_shipmode, q1, q2, q3, q4
ORDER BY l_shipmode
